Gap Cuts Outlook After Warm Fall Weather Weighs on Sales

The apparel company now expects total sales for the year to be roughly flat

By

Gap GAP -5.29 % decrease; down pointing triangle lowered its outlook after warmer weather in the fall weighed on third-quarter results.

The apparel company now expects total sales for the year to be roughly flat, compared with earlier guidance that revenue would increase by 1% to 1.5%.
